name: Nevada (NRS 608)
needsChecking: Not verified. Every value here was written from general knowledge of the law and must be checked against the official sources below before anyone relies on it; KeaS shows it as a suggestion until then.

overtime.note: NRS 608.018: daily overtime over 8 h in a 24-hour period applies only to employees paid less than 1.5x the minimum wage; KeaS can't tell that yet and applies daily overtime to everyone in Nevada (which can overpay, never underpay). The 24-hour window isn't the calendar day KeaS uses. Needs checking.

minimumWage.note: The NV minimum wage isn't filled in yet: check this year's rate (and any city or county rate) and add it. Until then only the federal minimum is checked.

sickLeave.capKind: hours an employer may limit use to each year
sickLeave.note: Paid leave for any reason (not only sickness) at about 0.01923 h per hour worked (1 h per 52), for employers with 50 or more employees. Use may wait 90 days. Needs checking.
